30th sunday in ordinary time sunday 25th october 2026 almighty ever-living god, increase our faith, hope and charity, and make us love what you command, so that we may merit what you promise. through our lord jesus christ, your son, who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the holy spirit, god, for ever and ever. st vincent de paul helpline number: 07845 854671 to donate directly to our bank account, the details are as follows: account name: ulster bank springhill account number: 10523499 sort code: 98-07-60 if you would prefer to phone directly to donate money, please phone

and mention holywood. thank you for your continued support during these difficult times. if you can, please remember to gift aid your donation sensory-friendly mass invitation st colmcille’s parish ballyhackamore warmly invites you to our monthly sensory mass on saturday, 31st october at 12:00 noon. this special mass is designed to be inclusive and welcoming for individuals and families who may benefit from a quieter, more relaxed worship environment. the short mass will feature: gentle lighting and sound; a calm and supportive atmosphere; space to move around if needed; sensory items to aid regulation; a warm welcome for all ages and abilities. whether you or a loved one experience sensory sensitivities, or you simply wish to attend a short peaceful and reflective service, we would love to see you there. refreshments after mass. abide in his love women’s conference. the great northern hotel, bundoran, 20th –22nd november 2026. join women from across ireland for a faith-filled weekend with inspiring speakers including sarah swafford, danielle noonan, fr mark wharton, fr barry braum, fr oisín martin, the dominican sisters of nashville, bishop fintan gavin, and more. a conference not to be missed! register now:
https://abideinhislove.eventbrite.com/

church cleaning morning monday 26th october at 10am. if you can spare an hour, we’d love your help many hands make light work! thank you! the road home sunday 22 november 2026 , 7.00pm clonard monastery, belfast join cappella caeciliana, directed by james grossmith, for an evening of uplifting choral music celebrating belonging, hope and the choir’s 31st anniversary. featuring ruth mcginley (piano) and thomas isaac (cello), the concert marks st cecilia’s day. tickets: £20 | under 25s: £5 book:

down and connor diocesan trust holywood parish vacancy ‘assistant parish support officer’ would you like to play a key role in supporting parish life and helping to ensure the smooth day- to-day running of a busy parish office? holywood parish is seeking to recruit an assistant parish support officer to provide confidential, efficient and effective administrative support to the parish support officer and parish priest, while offering a welcoming and professional service to parishioners and visitors. the terms are based on a permanent appointment requiring 20 hours per week. work pattern : monday to thursday from 10.00 am to 3.00 pm. rate of pay - £14.04 gross per hour full details relating to the vacancy can be found on the diocesan website at:
http://www.downandconnor.org

clicking on the tab: job vacancies and on the community ni website, where terms and conditions relating to the role can also be accessed by way of a role profile and employment application form. application packs can also be obtained from holywood parish office. we welcome applications from anyone who feels they meet the criteria and are interested in playing an active part in the parish. closing date for applications will be 12.00 noon on tuesday 27 october 2026 down and connor diocesan trust is an equal opportunities employer

wednesday morning coffee mornings are back! everyone is warmly invited to join us for tea, coffee and a friendly chat on wednesdays after mass. we look forward to seeing you! november short-term pledge the month of november offers a special opportunity to make a small sacrifice in honour of the sacred heart of jesus. we invite parishioners and friends to consider taking a short-term pledge throughout november. pioneer offering - "i promise, in honour of the sacred heart of jesus, and with the help of the blessed virgin mary, to abstain from all intoxicating substances until the end of november." please consider joining with others in prayer, sacrifice and support for those affected by addiction. day pilgrimage to knock on monday 2nd november for feast of all souls, leaving st agnes at 7.30am. price £30 (includes tea and scone). contact pat

. mass to remember deceased members of the pioneer association a mass to remember all deceased members of the pioneer association will take place on friday 20 november in st agnes' church, andersonstown road, belfast at 7 pm. light refreshments afterwards. all pioneers welcome. knock all night vigil : departing clonard monastery at 1pm. monday 7th december returning to belfast tuesday 8th december at noon price £75. includes dinner and breakfast. to book: please call brendan on

9am to 5pm mon to fri. deposits can be paid at shearer butchers andersonstown road. vigil starts at 11pm and consists of the rosary, stations of the cross, benediction and finishes with mass at 4am all are invited to come and hear from representatives of 6 christian churches who will consider: 'who is mary in god’s plan of salvation?' martina purdy will present on behalf of the catholic tradition. there also will be time for audience questions, chaired by alf mccreary (belfast telegraph, bbc news) . this is an opportunity to listen and understand other perspectives. wednesday, 2 december 2026 at 7pm in corr’s corner hotel, newtownabbey. refreshments will be served. to aid in planning please rsvp to
ecumenical@downandconnor.org

or via qr code available on the poster in the porch. centering prayer group: we are pleased to announce the centering prayer has resumed. centering prayer group offers a quiet and peaceful opportunity to step away from the business of everyday life and spend some time simply being still in god’s presence. centering prayer is a simple form of silent prayer that helps us to deepen our relationship with god and grow in openness, trust and peace. no previous experience is necessary — just come as you are. whether you are new to centering prayer or already familiar with it, you will be very welcome. it is a chance to pause, pray, reflect and share this quiet time with others. everyone is warmly invited to join us in iona on tuesday mornings after mass safeguarding training – behind the screens the national board for safeguarding children in the catholic church in ireland is offering a four-session online training programme, “behind the screens”, exploring the opportunities, challenges and risks of young people’s engagement in the online world. the training is aimed at those involved in children’s ministry, faith formation, youth work, youth ministry and pastoral care. cost: €20 per session | online via zoom sessions take place on: 4 november 9 november 18 november 9 december 2026 further information is on our website. community set dancing classes in holywood continue on mondays (7.30pm - 9.00pm). great exercise and good fun. very different to riverdance. no need to come with a partner - just comfortable shoes and a friendly disposition! this is an adult class but children over the age of 14 are welcome but need to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. each class costs £5 (£3 for those under 25). please call kevin macmahon on 07940 803839 to reserve a place or for further information beginning experience : the loss of a partner through death, separation or divorce is devastating. beginning experience is offering a programme of bereavement support in st bride’s hall, derryvolgie ave., belfast booking essential . to find out more, contact pauline

stay connected with our parish! join the ppc facebook page! want to stay up to date with parish news, events, announcements, photos, and other important information? follow and like our ppc facebook page to keep connected with our parish community throughout the week. find us on facebook: st colmcilles parish join us online. stay connected. be part of our parish community! requests for masses for deceased relatives and friends in remembrance of loved ones – to request a mass for an intention of a family member or friend. please give your request either by calling the office
(option 2) or by sending an email to
holywood@downandconnor.org

although we cannot guarantee the date you request will be available, fr stephen will be offering a mass for the intention each day thank god and sincere thanks also to our many listeners and supporters as radio maria ireland continues to grow. as an irish-run catholic talk- radio station we enjoy commercial free broadcasting - prayer, catechesis, uplifting music, talks, interviews and testimonies – do join our growing faith family! here’s how you can listen: via digital tv - saorview channel 210 download our free app “radio maria ireland” streaming on our website -
via our ‘listen live radio’ link on our facebook page. why not drop a line to our spiritual director, fr des farren by text on

, by phone on 01-4123456, or come and pay us a visit at radio maria ireland, st. anthony’s business park, ballymount road, dublin 22. d22 r7w2 as the season of advent approaches, manresa jesuit centre of spirituality invites religious members and parishioners to take part in its upcoming advent retreats . these retreats offer an opportunity to step away from the busyness of the season, make space for prayer and reflection, and prepare spiritually for christmas. manresa jesuit centre of spirituality 426 clontarf road, d03 fp52 advent 2026 retreat offerings advent triduum retreat: monday –friday, 30 november –4th december or monday –friday, 14th –18th december . this guided silent retreat offers participants an opportunity to step away uy67t5ed3x c rom the busyness of the season and spend time reflecting on the themes of advent —a time of waiting, watching, and preparing for the mystery of christ’s coming. advent weekend retreat: friday –sunday, 4 –6 december centred on the core themes of advent, this weekend retreat includes time for personal prayer and reflection, prayer with others, and the opportunity to meet with a spiritual director. it offers participants a chance to step away from the many demands of the season and make space to notice where god’s spirit may be moving. for more information, visit manresa.ie or contact manresa’s reception team at
reception@manresa.ie
